description: This file contains SwiftUI views and supporting shapes for rendering chat message UI components in a messaging app, including message bubbles, typing indicators, and auxiliary elements.

classes.name: ChatBubbleShape
classes.description: A custom shape for chat bubbles with optional tails on left or right.

classes.name: ChatMessageBubble
classes.description: View for rendering a chat message with dynamic styling based on sender.

classes.name: ChatMessageBody
classes.description: Sub-view for the contents of a chat message including text, attachments, and tool-related info.

classes.name: AttachmentRow
classes.description: View for displaying a file or attachment associated with a message.

classes.name: ToolCallCard
classes.description: Component displaying details of a tool call within chat.

classes.name: ToolResultCard
classes.description: Component for rendering the result of a tool execution, with toggle for full output.

classes.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
classes.description: View showing animated dots indicating typing...

classes.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
classes.description: View for live-updating assistant message streaming bubble.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
classes.description: Displays a list of currently running tools in chat.

classes.name: ChatAssistantTextBody
classes.description: Render helper for assistant messages, parsing and styling segments of text.

methods.name: inset
methods.description: Adjusts the shape's inset amount.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Generates the Path for the shape based on tail position.

methods.name: rightTailPath
methods.description: Constructs the Bezier path for a tail on the right of the bubble shape.

methods.name: leftTailPath
methods.description: Constructs the Bezier path for a tail on the left of the bubble shape.

methods.name: addBottomEdge
methods.description: Helper to add bottom edge curves to bubble shapes.

methods.name: body
methods.description: View provider rendering chat message bubble with styling and content.

methods.name: primaryText
methods.description: Concatenates textual content parts into the main message string.

methods.name: inlineAttachments
methods.description: Filters message content to extract attachments.

methods.name: toolCalls
methods.description: Filters message content for tool call elements.

methods.name: inlineToolResults
methods.description: Filters message content for tool result elements.

methods.name: isToolResultMessage
methods.description: Determines if the message role indicates a tool result.

methods.name: toolResultTitle
methods.description: Generates the title for a tool result card.

methods.name: bubbleFillColor
methods.description: Calculates the fill color based on message sender and style.

methods.name: bubbleBackground
methods.description: Defines the background style for the message bubble.

methods.name: bubbleBorderColor
methods.description: Determines bubble border color based on context.

methods.name: bubbleBorderWidth
methods.description: Determines border width based on context.

methods.name: bubbleBorder
methods.description: Creates the view for the bubble's border.

methods.name: bubbleShape
methods.description: Defines the shape with tail direction.

methods.name: bubbleTail
methods.description: Decides tail position based on message style.

methods.name: tailPaddingLeading
methods.description: Padding on leading edge for onboard style.

methods.name: tailPaddingTrailing
methods.description: Padding on trailing edge for onboard style.

methods.name: bubbleShadowColor
methods.description: Shadow color under bubble if applicable.

methods.name: bubbleShadowRadius
methods.description: Shadow radius for bubble.

methods.name: bubbleShadowYOffset
methods.description: Vertical offset for shadow.

methods.name: updateAnimationState
methods.description: Handles toggling animation for typing indicator

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Splits text content into lines for toggle display.

methods.name: displayContent
methods.description: Formats the tool result text for display.
